formula: Total current assets ÷ Total current liabilities
explanation: Current ratio = Total current assets ÷ Total current liabilities = 60 ÷ 40 = 1.5 times. It shows how many times short-term assets cover short-term obligations.
Debt-equity ratio = Total debt (borrowings) ÷ Shareholders' funds = 50 ÷ 100 = 0.5. Trade payables and other current liabilities are not debt.
Interest coverage = EBIT (profit before interest and tax) ÷ Interest expense = 30 ÷ 6 = 5 times. Use profit BEFORE interest, because interest is paid out of it.
Net profit margin = Net profit (after tax) ÷ Revenue from operations × 100 = 18 ÷ 200 × 100 = 9%.
Return on equity = Net profit (after tax) ÷ Shareholders' funds × 100 = 18 ÷ 100 × 100 = 18%. It shows the return earned for the shareholders.
Inventory turnover = Cost of goods sold ÷ Inventories = 120 ÷ 20 = 6 times. Use cost of goods sold, not revenue, because inventory is carried at cost.
